items.title: Modern Mansion Roleplay
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Are you ready to be a millionaire and live the modern day life of your dreams? With this immersive mansion roleplay set, you'll be able to do that and more! If you're looking for a survival spawn with unique furniture, a beautiful mansion, and beautiful scenery, this map is perfect for you!

- Includes 12 furniture models that can be crafted and placed around the map!

items.title: Cool Teens
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
It takes swag to be a cool teen. Pick up some luxury attire and be confident. With rich millionaires among us, you have to walk the city streets with your friends and stand out!

+ 11 skins
+ 1 free skin

items.title: Ready for School
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Hey you! Tired of doing the same thing over and over in class and just want something new? Explore real school life with these 10 adventurous skins. Are you ready to have some fun and break some rules? 

+ Includes 10 cute school teens
+ Perfect for school roleplays
+ By greay

items.title: Hidden Submarine Base
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Have you ever wanted to explore an awesome submarine base? Even better, what about a hidden submarine base? Do you dare to find the secrets of the ocean? It's your time to shine!

- Several types of chambers and rooms
- Beautiful oceans to explore! 
- Multiplayer compatible
- By Block Tale Studios

items.title: Demon Teen
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
The demons have arrived, and they are already among us! Have fun with these 10 incredible skins and spread the terror around!

- By Street Studios

items.title: Skyblock Lucky Block
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
You love skyblock and you love lucky blocks! If you feel lucky, test your luck with the perfect combination of your favorite game modes! Find lucky blocks in the world and trade for more! Will you get a positive outcome or spawn a dangerous mob?

+ Custom trader
+ 200+ outcomes
+ Many islands
+ Custom Nether and End

items.title: Creatures of The End
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Don't creep in the dark, the end is nearby! 

+ 8 horror skins
+ Dark monsters that are perfect for Halloween
+ 1 FREE skin: Smile

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Sea Explorer
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Be ready to explore in the deep waters and start your adventure by exploring sunken ships, the underwater town, and the great coral reef. Be careful in eddy currents, the water is very dangerous there. Explore the whole deepwater world and find out what the underwater world has to offer. 

+ 4 skins included
+ Licensed by Pixel Creations and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Trendy School Teens
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Do you want to arrive back in school looking super trendy and fashionable? Pick from the 8 amazing summer outfits and become the most awesome teen in school!

- 8 AWESOME skins
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from UniDesigns.

items.title: Axolotl Knights
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Who says you can’t be cute and a fearsome warrior? Lose the bucket and swim into your armor!

- 10 adorably deadly axo-knight-ol skins! 
- Licensed by The Pocalypse Studios and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Anime Cuties
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Be ready to catch everyone's eye! Roleplay with these 12 anime-themed skins with your friends and explore the wonders of Minecraft together. Everything is possible!

- 12 anime-themed skins
- 1 free skin
- Licensed by Dragon Blocks and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Superheroes
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Be it super speed, flight, invisibility, or super strength, this pack has the perfect suit to fit your personality and power! These skins offer a stylish and functional interface for saving lives, fighting villains, and other heroic duties. Find your true calling as a superhero today!

- 12 Super Skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Frog Teens
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Ribbit! The frog squad teens are back in town, and ready to hop into action! Join them today with this fun and trendy frog-themed pack! Froggie hat, anyone?

- 12 Froggie Teens!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Greek Legends
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Live in the time when gods roamed the land and the strongest survived with these PvP masters. Be prepared to thrive among your fellow greek citizens, fight in any battle, whether it be in an arena or for Sparta, you'll be ready for whatever is thrown your way!

- 8 Greek Legend skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Mega Lucky World
items.creator: Diluvian
items.description: A lucky explosion! Explore this world where the trees and even giant mobs are made of lucky blocks, are you ready?

items.title: Giant Parkour Mobs
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description: Pigs, cows, blazes and many more mobs!! All these little creatures are giant size for a giant adventure! Can you finish all mob levels?

items.title: Futuristic Secret Base
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description: On this bunker hidden in a normal house a massive futuristic base was built, explore all its secrets and adventure yourself. Can you find the rocket area?

items.title: Cyber City
items.creator: Cynosia
items.description:
Welcome to Cyber City, a stunning, high-tech metropolis! Take flying cars for a spin, customize cyborg pets, and interact with cybernetic citizens! Put on a cyberpunk skin to explore massive skyscrapers and a sprawling futuristic cityscape, but watch out for angry robots!
+ 166 vehicles and 10 customizable pets
+ Single and multiplayer minigames and race tracks
+ 10 skins

items.title: Mobs of the Month - September
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Calling all goth, punk, metal, and emo teens! We've got a pack of misfit mobs for you this September! 12 Skins to choose from.

items.title: Draco Dynasty
items.creator: JFCrafters
items.description: Experience traditional survival in the beauty that it was meant to be with a full 128x128 texture pack.

items.title: Sunset Villa
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Welcome to Sunset Villa! Relax on the beach or run parkour as you explore this cozy town! Venture through the villa and discover houses, campsites, and more!

- Parkour courses 
- Hidden treasures around the map
- Perfect for roleplaying with friends
- Licensed by Xenon Design and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Hacker School - Roleplay
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Are you ready to become a real hacker? Learn various hacking techniques with interactive NPC professors. Enjoy the huge school with many classrooms, visit a hacking science center. 

+ Interactable furniture
+ Huge school and town
+ Perfect for roleplay
+ Licensed by Pixel Creations and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Tech Mobs
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: Check out these unique cyber-themed mobs! Creeper, Enderman, Blaze, and more—these characters have gotten a fresh new look. Which one is your favorite?

items.title: World Hackers
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
The World Hackers are taking over! They deployed multiple hacks in the world that is causing a system overdrive! Choose any of these awesome outfits and take over the world.

+ 9 skins
